subject: general
question: The manufacturing of refrigerators that do not release chlorofluorocarbons has been made mandatory throughout the world. How will this help to prevent ozone depletion?

options.text: It will reduce the release of CFCs that react with ozone molecules.
It will help convert oxygen molecules into ozone.
CFCs will change into ozone molecules.
It will reduce the production of CFCs from oxygen molecules.

solution:
The correct answer is __**option 1**__

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Option 1** is correct because it accurately states that reducing the release of chlorofluorocarbons (CFCs) will reduce the reaction of CFCs with ozone molecules, which is a primary cause of ozone depletion.
 
• CFCs are chemicals that, when released into the atmosphere, break down ozone molecules, leading to the thinning of the ozone layer.
